items.title: Schneider Electric (ENXTPA:SU) Unveiled Edge AI Tools For Industrial Sites
items.summary: Schneider Electric (ENXTPA:SU) announced a collaboration with NVIDIA and Hewlett Packard Enterprise to speed up Physical AI deployment at the industrial edge. The partnership focuses on running AI workloads closer to factories and plants to address data governance, cybersecurity, and cost constraints. Schneider Electric also introduced TeSys Tera, an intelligent motor management system designed to bring real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance to aging facilities. The collaboration...

items.title: Citi cuts Adobe rating on ’rising risk of a hard reset’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi downgraded Adobe to Sell, saying it sees downside risk to consensus growth estimates into fiscal 2027 as a leadership transition coincides with mounting competitive and macro pressure on the company’s Creative business.

items.title: Elon says Grok Bot costs more than it makes
items.summary: Elon Musk says the cost of serving Grok Bot is unsustainably high relative to revenue, and usage limits just tightened for paying users. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why the same chips earn more rented to Anthropic, the $60 billion Cursor bet, the bear and bull case, and whether AI is too expensive at today's prices.

items.title: HP Inc. Appoints Emma Walmsley as Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Bruce Broussard to Succeed Chip Bergh as Chair of the Board PALO ALTO, Calif., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HP Inc. (NYSE: HPQ) today announced that its Board of Directors has unanimously appointed Emma Walmsley as Chief Executive Officer, effective January 4, 2027. Ms. Walmsley most recently served as Chief Executive Officer of GSK and has been a member of Microsoft’s Board of Directors for seven years.
